intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Welcome to the design system - Complete guide to components, variants and best practices

intro.whatIsDescription: This design system is built with Astro and native CSS, offering:

features.reusableDesc: Link, Button, Input, Card, Badge, Alert, etc.
features.cssNativeDesc: Easy customization via CSS custom properties

intro.structureDescription: The project is logically organized to facilitate navigation and maintenance:
intro.variantsDescription: Each component can be displayed in different visual styles called variants. The four available variants are:
intro.variantInitialDesc: Clean and modern design with crisp lines and subtle colors.
intro.variantRetroDesc: Vintage inspiration with character fonts and nostalgic colors.
intro.variantModernDesc: Contemporary style with gradients and elegant visual effects.
intro.variantFuturisticDesc: Avant-garde design with neon, glassmorphism and cyberpunk effects.
intro.howToUseDescription: To use a specific variant, simply pass the variant prop to the component:
intro.darkModeDescription: All components automatically support dark mode. The system automatically detects user preference and applies the appropriate theme.

about.heroSubtitle: Concordia is a civic platform, designed to bring together residents, associations and local actors within a single trusted space.
about.whyBody1: In an increasingly fragmented world, Concordia creates digital spaces that strengthen neighborhood life. Our platform connects residents to local initiatives, nearby services and the people who bring their community to life.
about.whyBody2: We believe technology should be invisible: a simple, accessible tool that amplifies bonds rather than replacing them.
